entries.e72175d5c819498f: PayPay Corporation is now a company that handles the finance business (payment and financial services) of the SoftBank business.
entries.e7f775db4040ef2e: Revenue from mobile services and broadband services, and revenue from sales of mobile handsets (product sales)
entries.e90c49f01fb7a5ea: Announced a Japan-U.S. public-private partnership project to develop power generation facilities and an AI data center together in Ohio, United States
entries.e9c8da69bb23c514: PayPay Corporation listed on the U.S. Nasdaq Global Select Market
entries.f155480a576062f5: This is the announcement of a plan to develop power generation facilities and an AI data center together.
entries.f1ffc9d3996eb55b: This business designs semiconductor IP (design information), chips and related technologies, develops and sells semiconductor chips, and sells software tools and provides related services. It is run by Arm Holdings plc, Ampere Computing Holdings LLC, Graphcore Limited and others. Following the completion of the acquisition of Ampere in the three months ended December 31, 2025, this newly established reportable segment combines Arm, which was in the former 'Arm Business', Graphcore Limited and others, which were in 'Others', and Ampere. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥640,309 million (¥590,301 million in the previous year, restated), the second largest of the four reportable segments. Number of employees is 11,439 (as of March 31, 2026; temporary employees are separately 206).
entries.f36e5e3ae81ec1bf: This business provides mobile services and solution services to corporate customers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, cloud service revenue grew as corporate digitalization advanced.
entries.f6966a694d22305b: In January 2025, the company announced the "Stargate Project" to build AI infrastructure for OpenAI, a U.S. AI research and development company. In March of the same year, it committed to make an additional investment of $30 billion in OpenAI, and this investment was completed in December of the same year.
entries.f6afaf17e05d3cee: SVF2 is the second SoftBank Vision Fund. Its duration is until October 4, 2032, and its operating company is SB Global Advisers Limited. The investment in OpenAI from 2025 to 2026 was also made through SVF2.
entries.f8719944d4c39813: This is the second fund operated by SoftBank Vision Fund II-2 L.P., which began operations in October 2019. Its term runs until October 4, 2032 (the operating company has options for up to two one-year extensions). Investments in OpenAI, including the additional investment committed in March 2025 and the additional US$30 billion investment committed in February 2026, are made through SVF2.
entries.f8e05aa1bd422fdc: It is Arm Holdings plc, a semiconductor design company in Cambridge, UK. Arm's technology is used in diverse products such as smartphones, data center servers, IoT and automobiles, and it provides compute platforms that combine high performance with power efficiency. It has three business units: 'Edge AI', 'Cloud AI' and 'Physical AI'; revenue in US dollar terms for the fiscal year ended March 2026 rose 9.5% from the previous year on higher royalty income. In March 2026, it announced the Arm AGI CPU, its first in-house designed silicon chip since its founding. The company's voting rights ownership ratio is 86.7% (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.fb234201d94a0453: In September 1981, the company established Nippon SoftBank Co., Ltd. in Yonbancho, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, and began a distribution business for packaged software for personal computers.
entries.fea00fa525885e2f: It is Graphcore Limited, based in Bristol, UK.
entries.ff9b3a9bfe90d51f: The company, which had registered its shares with the Japan Securities Dealers Association in July 1994, listed on the First Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in January 1998. This market moved to the TSE Prime Market in the review of market segments in April 2022.
